Overview

Freiburg is a city in Baden-Württemberg with a population of 231,000. Germany’s greenest city, nestled in the Black Forest, a solar-powered university town with a stunning Gothic cathedral and a sunny climate. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
